name: streamify-microservices
description: Root orchestrator for streamify-microservices (user, admin, song services + frontend)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix "user service" && npm install --prefix "admin service" && npm install --prefix "song service" && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n USER,ADMIN,SONG,FRONTEND -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:song" "npm run dev:frontend"
